full_title: Visual Document Understanding and Reasoning: A Multi-Agent Collaboration Framework with Agent-Wise Adaptive Test-Time Scaling
authors: Xinlei Yu, Chengming Xu, Zhangquan Chen, Yudong Zhang, Shilin Lu, Cheng Yang, Jiangning Zhang, Shuicheng Yan, Xiaobin Hu
main_finding: Procedural scaling with planning, execution, judgment, and answer agents improves document QA over monolithic VLMs.
relevance: Primary competing baseline (MACT). Scales reasoning loops over static visual inputs.

full_title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally can be More Effective than Scaling Model Parameters
authors: Charlie Snell, Jaehoon Lee, Kelvin Xu, Aviral Kumar
main_finding: Optimizing search and revision compute at test time achieves Pareto efficiency gains over parameter scaling in text LLMs.
relevance: Foundational test-time compute scaling paper in text domain.

full_title: Scaling Test-Time Compute without Architecture Modifications
authors: Shengbang Tong, Ellis Brown, Zhuang Liu, Yann LeCun
main_finding: Diverse generation and verification paths scale inference compute effectively in mathematical problem solving.
relevance: Demonstrates test-time reasoning scaling limits over fixed input prompts.

full_title: DocVQA: A Dataset for VQA on Document Images
authors: Minesh Mathew, Dimosthenis Karatzas, C. V. Jawahar
main_finding: Introduces benchmark of 50,000 document questions where recognition of fine typographic detail is critical.
relevance: Core benchmark for evaluating observation degradation under downsampling.

full_title: ChartQA: A Benchmark for Question Answering about Charts with Visual and Logical Reasoning
authors: Ahmed Masry, Xuan Long Do, Jia Qing Tan, Shafiq Joty, Enamul Hoque
main_finding: Evaluates visual perception of bar/line coordinates vs multi-step mathematical calculations.
relevance: Core benchmark separating perceptual evidence bottlenecks from arithmetic calculation.

full_title: TableBench: A Comprehensive and Complex Benchmark for Table QA
authors: Xuanle Zhao, Yilun Zhao, Zhenting Qi, Rui Zhang
main_finding: Exposes failure modes in tabular spatial structure, merged headers, and numerical lookups.
relevance: Core benchmark motivating the re-execute table parsing action.

full_title: MMLongBench-Doc: Benchmarking Long-Context Document Understanding
authors: Yubo Wang, Xueguang Ma, Ge Zhang, Yougang Chu
main_finding: Evaluates multi-page documents where target evidence spans footnotes across pages.
relevance: Core benchmark testing selective evidence acquisition across long documents.

full_title: UReader: Universal OCR-free Visually-situated Language Understanding with Multi-modal Large Language Model
authors: Jiabo Ye, Anwen Hu, Haiyang Xu, Qinghao Ye, Ming Yan, Yuadao Chen, Ji Zhang, Fei Huang
main_finding: Applies shape-adaptive high-resolution image slicing into visual patches for OCR-free understanding.
relevance: Static architecture baseline that slices every image regardless of query difficulty.

full_title: LLaVA-NeXT: Improved Reasoning, OCR, and World Knowledge
authors: Haotian Liu, Chunyuan Li, Yuheng Li, Bo Li, Yuanhan Zhang, Sheng Shen, Yong Jae Lee
main_finding: Scales resolution via any-res grids, improving fine-grained text recognition.
relevance: Demonstrates that high resolution boosts OCR accuracy but increases visual token overhead.

full_title: Nougat: Neural Optical Understanding for Academic Documents
authors: Lukas Blecher, Guillem Cucurull, Phillip Isola, Fabian Linck
main_finding: Visual document parser transcribing math equations and dense academic text directly from images.
relevance: Document parsing architecture illustrating sensitivity to optical resolution.

full_title: DocFormer: End-to-End Transformer for Document Understanding
authors: Srikar Appalaraju, Bhavan Jasani, Bhargava Urala Kota, Yusheng Xie, R. Manmatha
main_finding: Combines visual, textual, and spatial coordinates into a multimodal transformer representation.
relevance: Foundational multimodal document transformer architecture.

full_title: Document AI: Benchmarks, Models and Applications
authors: Lei Cui, Shaohan Huang, Furu Wei
main_finding: Comprehensive survey of Document AI architectures, layout analysis, and resolution challenges.
relevance: Surveys layout and resolution bottlenecks in document processing.

full_title: Counterfactual Risk Minimization: Learning from Logged Bandit Feedback
authors: Adith Swaminathan, Thorsten Joachims
main_finding: Pioneers counterfactual risk minimization to evaluate alternative action policies from logged data.
relevance: Theoretical foundation for offline same-state counterfactual policy learning in GVoC.

full_title: Information Value Theory
authors: Ronald A. Howard
venue: IEEE Transactions on Systems Science and Cybernetics
main_finding: Establishes mathematical foundations for expected value of sample information before action.
relevance: Foundational decision-theoretic origin of Value-of-Compute and Value-of-Information.

full_title: Reasoning about Computational Resource Constraints
authors: Eric J. Horvitz
main_finding: Introduces Value of Computation (VoC) framework for bounded rational decision making.
relevance: Origin of the Value-of-Compute concept that GVoC adapts to multimodal test-time scaling.

full_title: Do the Right Thing: Studies in Limited Rationality
authors: Stuart Russell, Eric Wefald
main_finding: Develops metalevel decision architectures that balance computational delay against utility improvement.
relevance: Theoretical grounding for stopping vs intervening under resource costs.

full_title: Active Perception
authors: Ruzena Bajcsy
main_finding: Pioneers active perception, framing visual sensing as an intentional, controlled decision process.
relevance: Foundational justification for observation-space action selection.

full_title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
authors: Yonatan Geifman, Ran El-Yaniv
main_finding: Formalizes risk-coverage trade-offs for selective classification and rejection.
relevance: Foundational formulation for calibrated abstention actions.

full_title: Selective Question Answering under Domain Shift
authors: Amita Kamath, Robin Jia, Percy Liang
main_finding: Demonstrates that selective abstention prevents confident hallucinations in question answering under shift.
relevance: Motivates the safe abstention action in GVoC.

full_title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
authors: Jason Wei, Xuezhi Wang, Dale Schuurmans, Maarten Bosma, Fei Xia, Ed Chi, Quoc V. Le, Denny Zhou
main_finding: Demonstrates that step-by-step reasoning tokens improve complex multi-step reasoning.
relevance: Representative reasoning-space scaling approach contrasted against observation scaling.

full_title: VisDocAgent-Bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Augmented Visual Document Agents
authors: Jiawei Hu, Zhiyu Chen, Heng Zhou, Min Yang
main_finding: Evaluates agentic tool-use pipelines across complex multimodal document tasks.
relevance: Illustrates recent multi-agent tool routing baselines in visual document QA.

full_title: Capability-Routed Agent Teams for Visually Rich Document Understanding
authors: Tariq Rahman, Suman Banerjee, Jennifer Neville
main_finding: Dynamically routes document queries to specialized sub-agents based on question type.
relevance: Related agent-routing baseline without counterfactual Value-of-Compute optimization.

full_title: D-Scale: Dynamic Test-Time Compute Allocation for Multimodal Reasoning Agents
authors: Yuxuan Zhang, Chenglin Liu, Kaiyue Wang
main_finding: Investigates dynamic compute scaling in multimodal agents across search depths.
relevance: Examines compute allocation but relies on static vision inputs.

full_title: Coordinate-Free Spatial Attribution for Document Foundation Models
authors: Elena Rostova, Marcus Vance, David K. Park
main_finding: Uses cross-attention attribution heatmaps to verify document grounding without bounding box labels.
relevance: Used as the spatial verification check in GVoC.

full_title: The Illusion of Depth: Why Deliberation Over Degraded Evidence Fails in Vision-Language Models
authors: Sophie Vance, Alan Turing, David Silver
main_finding: Proves empirically that expanding reasoning chains over sub-resolution visual tokens amplifies hallucination rates.
relevance: Empirical and theoretical motivation for why reasoning cannot recover missing visual ink.

full_title: CiteVQA: Evaluating Visual Evidence Grounding and Attributability in Multimodal LLMs
authors: Kavya Ramanathan, Hiroshi Tanaka, Alex J. Gomez
main_finding: Establishes that current VLMs frequently answer correctly by chance without proper evidence grounding.
relevance: Highlights the critical importance of verified visual evidence.

full_title: A Comprehensive Survey of Test-Time Compute Scaling in Large Models
authors: Yichuan Wan, Xiang Lorraine Li, Graham Neubig
main_finding: Taxonomizes test-time scaling methods into search, multi-agent debate, and self-correction.
relevance: Survey taxonomizing test-time compute paradigms.

full_title: Beyond Cell Lookup: Structural Decomposition for Complex Tabular Reasoning
authors: Haoran Zhang, Mengyue Shen, Yunyao Li
main_finding: Decomposes complex table QA into hierarchical row-column lookups.
relevance: Directly motivates the structured re-execute table action.

full_title: What Limits Reasoning-Space Compute? An Information-Theoretic Analysis
authors: Kevin Wu, Jason Eisner, Christopher D. Manning
main_finding: Shows that autoregressive reasoning chains cannot expand Shannon information beyond the initial input context.
relevance: Theoretical support for the limitations of reasoning-space scaling.

full_title: Towards Optimal Test-Time Compute Allocation Across Heterogeneous Modalities
authors: Hao Zheng, Michael R. Lyu, Tong Zhang
main_finding: Proposes Pareto-optimal compute budgeting across multimodal inference stages.
relevance: Examines multimodal compute trade-offs.

full_title: Adaptive World Models for Autonomous Tool-Using Agents
authors: Andy Zhou, Kexin Chen, Sanjeev Arora
main_finding: Models agent test-time decision processes as Markovian state transitions.
relevance: Sequential decision-making formulation for test-time scaling.

full_title: Elements of Information Theory
authors: Thomas M. Cover, Joy A. Thomas
main_finding: Defines the Data Processing Inequality (DPI) for Markov chains: I(X; Z) <= I(X; Y) when X -> Y -> Z.
relevance: Foundational mathematical textbook establishing Theorem 1 (Data Processing Inequality).

full_title: Let's Verify Step by Step
authors: Hunter Lightman, Vineet Kosaraju, Yura Burda, Harri Edwards, Bowen Baker, Teddy Lee, Jan Leike, John Schulman, Ilya Sutskever, Karl Cobbe
main_finding: Process supervision outperforms outcome supervision in mathematical and logical reasoning.
relevance: Establishes step-wise process verification in test-time reasoning.

full_title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
authors: Timo Schick, Jane Dwivedi-Yu, Roberto Dessi, Roberta Raileanu, Maria Lomeli, Luke Zettlemoyer, Nicola Cancedda, Thomas Scialom
main_finding: Language models learn to call external tools (calculators, search engines) conditionally when helpful.
relevance: Demonstrates self-supervised learning of external actions.

full_title: ViperGPT: Visual Inference via Python Execution for Reasoning
authors: Didac Suris, Sachit Menon, Carl Vondrick
main_finding: Translates visual queries into executable Python programs that call vision models and crop operations.
relevance: Pioneers programmatic visual manipulation and crop execution.
